theorems.name: Submission.cbrld_ns_ball_current_mass_le
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (ξ : Euclid P → MultiVector P n) (A : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (x : Euclid P) (ρ : ℝ), (∀ᵐ y ∂μ, ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) n, |ξ y α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α) → (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n, A ω = ∫ y in ball x ρ, ξ y ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) y) ∂μ) → A.mass ≤ μ (ball x ρ)
